Rebuilt all faces at n=17,18,19,23, verified 170n and 54n counts, cocycle alpha on every triangle, 8n four-cycle facets, alpha cap Gamma equal to the 16-facet octahedral sphere, and the closed dual adjacency cocycle evaluating oddly on that sphere. The local incidence bound, not finite examples alone, extends the collapse to all n>=17; algebraic cap/cup duality proves nontrivial multiplication. No manifold or integral ring classification is claimed.
